text: Does your shoulder pinch... when you bench or press overhead?
Most of the time, it's your shoulder blades. They're drifting forward instead of staying back.
First, check your form. Tuck your elbows to forty-five degrees, and squeeze your shoulder blades back before every rep.
Still pinching? Add rear delt flies and Y raises, two or three times a week.
Still hurts? See a physio. Save this.
